title.en: Collaborators - adding and the public page (phone)

intro.sr: Administrator dodaje saradnika (firmu sa sopstvenom stranicom i izlaznim linkom sa referalnim kodom), a javna stranica „Naši saradnici“ ga odmah prikazuje. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: An administrator adds a collaborator (a company with its own page and an outbound link carrying the referral code), and the public “Naši saradnici” page shows it at once. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
